title: Claude Cowork: guided work with files and reports
summary: Explore a practical walkthrough of delegating computer-based work to Claude, then connect the demonstration to a small task you can safely verify.
creator: Vaibhav Sisinty
exercise: Create a fictional sales table with five rows. Ask for a short summary and a chart. Compare every total with the source table and ask Claude to explain any mismatch before accepting the report.
limitation: Tool access and screens vary by account. A successful demonstration does not remove the need to review file permissions, calculations, and the final output.
prerequisites: Access to Claude with the demonstrated Cowork capability. Use a practice folder containing copies or fictional files, never your only copy of important work.
